groups.name: raf.redis.custom-cache
groups.description: Named cache configurations with individual TTL and key-prefix settings.

groups.name: raf.redisson
groups.description: Redisson distributed lock and client configuration.

properties.name: raf.redis.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable the Redis enhanced integration. Must be set to true to activate RedisTemplate and cache beans.

properties.name: raf.redis.trusted-packages
properties.description: Trusted package prefixes for Redis JSON polymorphic deserialization. Add your domain model packages here to allow type-safe deserialization.

properties.name: raf.redis.custom-cache
properties.description: Named cache configurations. Each key is a cache name used with @Cacheable(cacheNames = "...").

properties.name: raf.redis.custom-cache[*].time-to-live
properties.description: Cache entry TTL. Supports duration strings such as '10m', '1h', '30s'.

properties.name: raf.redis.custom-cache[*].cache-null-values
properties.description: Whether to cache null values. Caching nulls prevents cache penetration attacks.

properties.name: raf.redis.custom-cache[*].key-prefix
properties.description: Key prefix for this cache. Useful for namespace isolation in shared Redis instances.

properties.name: raf.redis.custom-cache[*].use-key-prefix
properties.description: Whether to prepend the key prefix when storing cache entries.

properties.name: raf.redisson.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable Redisson client for distributed locks and other distributed data structures.

properties.name: raf.redisson.address
properties.description: Redisson server address in redis:// or rediss:// format, e.g. redis://127.0.0.1:6379.

properties.name: raf.redisson.database
properties.description: Redis database index used by Redisson.

properties.name: raf.redisson.connection-minimum-idle-size
properties.description: Minimum idle connections maintained in the Redisson connection pool.

properties.name: raf.redisson.timeout
properties.description: Redisson command response timeout in milliseconds.

properties.name: raf.redisson.retry-attempts
properties.description: Number of retry attempts for failed Redisson commands.

properties.name: raf.redisson.retry-interval
properties.description: Interval between Redisson command retry attempts in milliseconds.
